GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keen early and passing the 1400m, got its head up when racing close to heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Settled 3rd Two Wide With Cover 4 Lengths 1000m, stayed back inside in worst ground Straightening Up , Just battled away final 200m # held ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly during the early stages. Near the 50m, was hampered when awkwardly placed on heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Ridden Along Settled Down 3rd Outside 3 Lengths off leader/winner 3 Wide x 800m 2 Lengths Just Held Ground to 400m then Couldn'T Go On - # run ended @ 400m

Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 3 Lengths Two Wide turning, steered 3 Wide Straightening Up and Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced fiercely approaching/rounding first turn.] # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced fiercely approaching and rounding the first turn. Checked to avoid heels near the 800m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 8 Lengths 3 Wide (slow pace), forced Four Wide at 2500m, worked forward and in 3 Wide at 1800m, Moved Up to 2 Lengths Two Wide turning, lost a length in straight. [Stewards: Travelled keenly early stages.] # wide/worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled keenly in the early stages. Raced wide and without cover until near the 2100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away OK. Not pushed early & raced @ rear on inside (10L from lead). Stayed @ rear on inside until pushed to chase @ 600m. Pressured Two Wide (7L from lead) on home turn. Ran on soundly Two Wide in straight. # OK from rear.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Obliged to alter course on entering the home straight. When questioned re tactics, Rdr advised not intention to settle as far back, however; gelding failed to muster speed, so obliged to settle at rear-added gelding never travelled in the early and middle stages, however approaching the 500m, responded to riding and finished the race off well.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Settled Down 4th 7 Lengths comf improved = Lead 3 Wide x 1100m, in Two Wide @ 900m 1 Lengths , off the bit @ 600m kept on okay to 100m, # not up to it
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 1300m, commenced to race keenly, improved onto heels and shifted wider. Permitted to stride forward in a three-wide position until settling outside the lead near the 900m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths Two Wide , Moved Up 3 Wide to take the lead with a lap to go, Headed when it laid out back turn, retook Lead 3 Wide at the 1050m, Held Together in front until being Headed at 500m, trailed Two Wide by under a length turning, Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early/middle stages.] # weak once headed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok bit keen settled down fourth one x one 3 Lengths (1800m), pushed on to park Outside Leader Soon After , Ridden Along into the Straight Quickly Beaten off, faded to last # keen/spent turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: C/O/T-settle midfield. Over-raced early when rider attempted to settle behind the leaders before being allowed to stride and lead near the 1600m. When over-racing near the 2000m, steadied from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing start 1 length & Settled Down 3 Lengths Four Wide , in 3 Wide at 1400m, Drifted Back to last 12 Lengths from the lead turning, compounded in Straight after rider eased it down. [Stewards: Weakened from 700m. Stewards questioned rider re her riding early/middle stages. App. jockey stated she was asked to be aggressive on it and take up a forward position. She said it began awkwardly, took some time to muster speed, in accordance with instructions despite being wide, she rode forward, however was not able to obtain cover raced Wide for most of the race. She added it weakened from 700m and, concerned with its action, elected to ease out of the race. Post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Trial required.] # weakened from 700m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced wide for the majority. Weakened from the 700m. When quest re ride in early & middle stages, Rdr stated asked to take up forward position-said after beginning awkwardly, gelding took some time to muster speed & in accordance with instructs & despite being wide, rode forward, however; was not able to obtain a position close to rail due to inside runners holding their positions-said obliged to race 3 wide for majority-added gelding commenced to weaken from 700m & tailed field. A post race vet exam no abs. Official trial prior to racing again. Passed to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , controlled race in front 1200m, Headed on the corner and faded to miss placing # led/beaten turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow into stride. Caught wide early before being ridden forward to obtain a leading position near 1800m. When quest re tactics, in leading in contrast to recent races, Rdr stated as gelding was up in distance, intention to be forward as has not been finishing races off-said although gelding was slow into stride, as previous starts, was always intention to be forward & for this reason, rode to obtain lead near 1800m-added gelding raced comfortably & finished off race well. Tnr confirmed instructs, adding same instructs as always, horse has just been slow to leave the gates.
